question: Please group all Italian customers into ten buckets for December 2021 by summing their profits from all products purchased (where profit is calculated as quantity_sold multiplied by the difference between unit_price and unit_cost), then divide the overall range of total monthly profits into ten equal intervals. For each bucket, provide the number of customers, and identify the minimum and maximum total profits within that bucket.
sql:
WITH customer_monthly_profits AS (
    SELECT 
        c.cust_id,
        SUM(s.quantity_sold * (ct.unit_price - ct.unit_cost)) as total_profit
    FROM customers c
    JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
    JOIN sales s ON c.cust_id = s.cust_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    JOIN costs ct ON s.prod_id = ct.prod_id AND s.time_id = ct.time_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'Italy' 
        AND t.calendar_year = 2021 
        AND t.calendar_month_name = 'December'
    GROUP BY c.cust_id
),
profit_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        MIN(total_profit) as min_profit,
        MAX(total_profit) as max_profit
    FROM customer_monthly_profits
),
bucket_boundaries AS (
    SELECT 
        min_profit,
        max_profit,
        (max_profit - min_profit) / 10.0 as interval_size
    FROM profit_stats
),
ranked_customers AS (
    SELECT 
        cm.cust_id,
        cm.total_profit,
        CASE 
            WHEN cm.total_profit < (SELECT min_profit FROM bucket_boundaries) + (SELECT interval_size FROM bucket_boundaries) THEN 1
            WHEN cm.total_profit < (SELECT min_profit FROM bucket_boundaries) + 2.0 * (SELECT interval_size FROM bucket_boundaries) THEN 2
            WHEN cm.total_profit < (SELECT min_profit FROM bucket_boundaries) + 3.0 * (SELECT interval_size FROM bucket_boundaries) THEN 3
            WHEN cm.total_profit < (SELECT min_profit FROM bucket_boundaries) + 4.0 * (SELECT interval_size FROM bucket_boundaries) THEN 4
            WHEN cm.total_profit < (SELECT min_profit FROM bucket_boundaries) + 5.0 * (SELECT interval_size FROM bucket_boundaries) THEN 5
            WHEN cm.total_profit < (SELECT min_profit FROM bucket_boundaries) + 6.0 * (SELECT interval_size FROM bucket_boundaries) THEN 6
            WHEN cm.total_profit < (SELECT min_profit FROM bucket_boundaries) + 7.0 * (SELECT interval_size FROM bucket_boundaries) THEN 7
            WHEN cm.total_profit < (SELECT min_profit FROM bucket_boundaries) + 8.0 * (SELECT interval_size FROM bucket_boundaries) THEN 8
            WHEN cm.total_profit < (SELECT min_profit FROM bucket_boundaries) + 9.0 * (SELECT interval_size FROM bucket_boundaries) THEN 9
            ELSE 10
        END as profit_bucket
    FROM customer_monthly_profits cm
    CROSS JOIN bucket_boundaries
),
all_buckets AS (
    SELECT 1 as profit_bucket UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5
    UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10
)
SELECT 
    ab.profit_bucket,
    COUNT(rc.cust_id) as customer_count,
    MIN(rc.total_profit) as min_total_profit,
    MAX(rc.total_profit) as max_total_profit
FROM all_buckets ab
LEFT JOIN ranked_customers rc ON ab.profit_bucket = rc.profit_bucket
GROUP BY ab.profit_bucket
ORDER BY ab.profit_bucket
